The material used in this study was the forged plate of 7085 Al alloy whose chemical composition was Al-7.56Zn-1.50Mg-1.45Cu-0.12Zr-0.06Fe-0.02Si (wt%). T7452 heat treatment involving a solution treating for 470 °C/6 h, followed by a cold compression for 5%, and a two-step aging of 120 °C/6 h + 160 °C/10 h was carried out for the plate.
